_comment: News-alert layer config. Fetch/dedup/pre-filter are rule-based (0 token). Only the LLM judge (judge.enabled) spends tokens. Tune freely; no code change needed.
_comment_benzinga: Free Basic tier serves GENERAL news with accurate stock tags but NOT server-side ticker filtering. We pull the firehose and filter locally by each story's stocks[].name.
_comment_finnhub: Per-ticker company-news is high-volume with LOOSE tagging (relays Yahoo aggregation). A text pre-gate (headline/summary must mention the ticker or company name) drops the obvious noise before anything reaches the LLM.
_comment_hours: SEC/US-market news window. Outside it the poller exits fast. --force bypasses.
_comment_judge: The LLM relevance/materiality judge. DISABLED until the Anthropic key + judge module are wired (Stage C). fetch cadence is every-5-min (Task Scheduler); judge runs at most every cadence_min minutes OR when the candidate queue reaches queue_trigger. Only materiality >= push_threshold is sent to Telegram.

judge._comment_provider: openai = direct API (metered key). codex_cli = local Codex CLI via ChatGPT subscription (no per-token; but slower ~15s/batch and depends on `codex login` staying valid). NO fallback — if the provider breaks you get no alerts, which is the signal that it broke.
judge._comment_freshness: max_age_hours: skip any article already older than this when first seen (drops stale rehashes / slow-surfacing aggregator content). suppress_repeat_days: once an event is pushed, suppress further articles about the SAME event for this many days.
